column1: # Generated by scripts/regen_tpmt_tables.py from CPIC's live API.
# Do not hand-edit. CI runs the script with --check.
# The hand-authored predecessor carried four function divergences from
# CPIC (*8, *23, *24, *3D), SIX wrong ALT bases including a *3A row that
# matched the reference base, and only 17 of 1225 diplotypes.
# rsid/alt are ';'-separated for multi-locus haplotypes; every locus in
# a row must match for the allele to be called.
# NOTE *17: not every defining locus is a single-nucleotide substitution (None:'C'); omitted rather than approximated.
# NOTE *19: not every defining locus is a single-nucleotide substitution (None:'G'); omitted rather than approximated.
# NOTE *27: not every defining locus is a single-nucleotide substitution (None:'C'); omitted rather than approximated.
# NOTE *28: not every defining locus is a single-nucleotide substitution (None:'G'); omitted rather than approximated.
